Game Overview

In Blast Sprunki, the core idea is straightforward: guide the endearing Green Sprunki through a shadowy world in this whimsical adventure. Strategically place explosives to navigate challenging terrains and hazards. With each level, sharpen your timing and strategy to achieve a perfect three-star rating. Embrace creativity to overcome every obstacle and master the art of precision.
